about.vision: To be recognized globally as a benchmark of artisanal bakery excellence and sustainable luxury patisserie.
storyParagraphs: What began as a quiet kitchen experiment in 2018 has blossomed into a beloved sanctuary for pastry lovers and celebration seekers alike.

At Liya's Bake, we believe that baking is a harmony of chemistry and soul. We never compromise on ingredients — using single-origin Valrhona chocolate, farm-fresh pasture eggs, and slow-fermented starters.
Whether you are marking an intimate milestone or celebrating a grand wedding, our bakers put meticulous care into every crumb.
about.mission: To elevate life's everyday and monumental moments through extraordinary, handcrafted baked delights.

products.description: Experience pure indulgence with our **Red Velvet Dream Cake**, featuring soft, velvety red sponge layered with rich cream cheese frosting and silky whipped cream. Every bite delivers the perfect balance of delicate cocoa flavor and smooth, creamy sweetness. Finished with elegant red velvet crumbs and a luxurious touch of white chocolate, this stunning cake is as beautiful as it is delicious. Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, or any special occasion, it's a dreamy dessert that leaves a lasting impression.
products.name: red velvet dream cake
Choco Lava Dream Cake
products.description: Indulge in the ultimate chocolate experience with our Choco Lava Dream Cake, crafted with layers of rich, moist chocolate sponge and filled with a luscious molten chocolate lava center. Frosted with silky chocolate ganache and finished with premium chocolate shavings, every bite melts in your mouth with an intense cocoa flavor and irresistible creaminess. Perfect for chocolate lovers, birthdays, celebrations, or any special occasion, this decadent delight is guaranteed to satisfy every sweet craving.

Experience the rich flavors of the Middle East with our Salankatia, a luxurious dessert made with a smooth, creamy base and generously topped with premium pistachios, crunchy mixed nuts, and a dusting of rich chocolate. Every spoonful delivers the perfect balance of creamy texture, nutty crunch, and delightful sweetness. Served fresh and chilled, Salankatia is a refreshing treat that's perfect for satisfying your dessert cravings anytime, anywhere.
products.name: Salankatia

products.description: Treat yourself to the irresistible elegance of our White Forest Cake, made with soft, fluffy vanilla sponge layered with silky whipped cream and sweet, juicy cherries. Finished with delicate white chocolate shavings and topped with fresh cherries, this delightful cake offers a perfect blend of creamy richness and fruity freshness. Light, smooth, and beautifully crafted, it's an ideal choice for birthdays, anniversaries, and every special celebration.
products.name: White Forest Cake
Black Forest Cake
products.description: Indulge in the timeless delight of our Black Forest Cake, a rich and decadent dessert crafted with layers of soft, moist chocolate sponge, filled with smooth whipped cream and luscious cherry filling. Finished with a generous coating of chocolate shavings and topped with juicy cherries, every slice offers the perfect balance of deep chocolate flavor, light creamy texture, and fruity sweetness. Whether it's for birthdays, celebrations, or simply satisfying your sweet cravings, this classic cake is a crowd favorite that never goes out of style.

Indulge in the irresistible taste of our Kunafa, a traditional Middle Eastern dessert made with delicate, crispy kunafa pastry layered with rich, creamy cheese and soaked in fragrant sugar syrup. Topped with crushed pistachios, every bite brings together a delightful combination of crispy, creamy, nutty, and sweet flavors. A luxurious dessert that's perfect for any celebration or simply satisfying your sweet cravings
products.name: kunafa
